patterns.name: ioctl_surface
patterns.rationale: driver ioctls remain one of the best bug-hunting surfaces.

patterns.name: user_pointer
patterns.rationale: drivers handling userspace pointers are direct trust boundaries.

patterns.name: copy_from_user
patterns.rationale: driver import paths often hide size and lifetime bugs.

patterns.name: copy_to_user
patterns.rationale: driver export paths are frequent info leak sites.

patterns.name: dma_or_mmio
patterns.rationale: DMA and MMIO handling often mix complex lifetimes with attacker control.

patterns.name: allocator
patterns.rationale: allocation around device control paths is a useful signal.

patterns.name: free_path
patterns.rationale: teardown logic in drivers often breaks under error paths.
